name: Compute Cluster S07: Lag, Lead & Calendar Shift
description: Tests: lag (>>), lead (<<), calendar_shift, forward_returns (price only — non-price denominator trap).
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c

lag_1 = close >> 1
lag_5 = close >> 5
lead_1 = close << 1
shifted_63d = calendar_shift(period=63D)(close)
shifted_365d = calendar_shift(period=365D)(close)

# === FORWARD_RETURNS: % return over N bars (PRICE ONLY) ===
fwd_ret_21 = forward_returns(close, 21)

# TRAP: forward_returns on non-price (near-zero denominator) → inf
# ✗ forward_returns(zscore, 21)  — z-score near 0 → explosion
# ✓ (zscore << 21) - zscore      — forward change, safe

xy_lines(title='Forward 21-bar Return', category='Temporal', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Fwd Return', color=Color.Green)]))(x_values=index(), y_values=fwd_ret_21)

xy_lines(title='Lag/Lead/Shift', category='Temporal', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue), LineSeriesSpec(name='Lag 1', color=Color.Red), LineSeriesSpec(name='Shift 63D', color=Color.Green)]))(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, lag_1, shifted_63d))
